# curl — 2007 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 2 curl CVEs of 2007 are in `data/cve/vendors/curl/2007.jsonl`.

### CVE-2007-4850
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2008-01-25 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 31053: PHP 5.2.5 - cURL 'safe_mode' Security Bypass (remote/php, 2008-01-23, verified=1)

curl/interface.c in the cURL library (aka libcurl) in PHP 5.2.4 and 5.2.5 allows context-dependent attackers to bypass safe_mode and open_basedir restrictions and read arbitrary files via a file:// request containing a \x00 sequence, a different vulnerability than CVE-2006-2563.
